freeze_policy: immutable after commit; changes require a new hypothesis version and a new preregistration

pipeline_contract.outcome_boundary: only closed bars strictly after immutable EDP/decision boundary

primary_hypotheses.metric: supporting event proportion with reset/reignition plus early response
primary_hypotheses.expected_direction: higher proportion is descriptive support; any failure examples count against generality
primary_hypotheses.success_evidence: candidate event has the fixed sequence and early response
primary_hypotheses.failure_evidence: candidate sequence with slow/failing/adverse path or success without sequence
primary_hypotheses.counterexample_count_method: count every event id in counterexample_event_ids; do not discard outliers or redefine the cutoff

primary_hypotheses.metric: p90/p95/p97.5 extreme-group mixed outcome table and extreme+1H own-state persistence split
primary_hypotheses.expected_direction: extreme-only group remains mixed and persistence split is not assumed monotonic
primary_hypotheses.success_evidence: high-distribution group contains fast and successful examples
primary_hypotheses.counterexample_count_method: count every event id in counterexample_event_ids; do not discard outliers or redefine the cutoff

primary_hypotheses.metric: fixed freshness-lag buckets vs TTP5, early MAE, MFE30 and MFE24
primary_hypotheses.expected_direction: fresh bucket has lower delay/adverse path descriptively
primary_hypotheses.success_evidence: fresh bucket has low lag and clean early path
primary_hypotheses.failure_evidence: stale bucket remains successful or fresh bucket is adverse
primary_hypotheses.counterexample_count_method: count every event id in counterexample_event_ids; do not discard outliers or redefine the cutoff

primary_hypotheses.metric: batch-level count/rate of clean response plus sustained expansion/no early severe SL
primary_hypotheses.expected_direction: breadth is reproducible and remains a descriptive batch statistic
primary_hypotheses.success_evidence: event meets all predeclared clean breadth components
primary_hypotheses.failure_evidence: event is eventual winner but misses one component
primary_hypotheses.counterexample_count_method: count every event id in counterexample_event_ids; do not discard outliers or redefine the cutoff

primary_hypotheses.metric: eventual-winner MFE24 group split by fixed adverse-path conditions
primary_hypotheses.expected_direction: bad-path winner count is non-zero and must not be hidden by MFE24
primary_hypotheses.success_evidence: late winner has severe early path
primary_hypotheses.failure_evidence: late winner has clean early path
primary_hypotheses.counterexample_count_method: count every event id in counterexample_event_ids; do not discard outliers or redefine the cutoff

primary_hypotheses.metric: own-state w12 delta/acceleration synchronization vs early-response outcomes
primary_hypotheses.expected_direction: synchronized group has more early-response examples descriptively
primary_hypotheses.success_evidence: all 15m/1H/4H own-state signs are positive with early response
primary_hypotheses.failure_evidence: synchronized group fails or fast response occurs without synchronization
primary_hypotheses.counterexample_count_method: count every event id in counterexample_event_ids; do not discard outliers or redefine the cutoff
